Name: Bert
Monologue: Hey, sup.... You by chance want any of my boot legged Tri-pads? They all have Goblin Guild Manifestos and Gankbing2 pre-installed on ‘em. It’s honestly really easy to hack them, all you gotta do is electronify the beepnap receptors and you’re golden. Look I'm telling you whatever you do, DO NOT buy any gizmos or gadgets from Googy. That gob is a total scam artist, I mean 50 brownie points for a Bipbopper 9000? RIP OFF MUCH??? Anyways I gotta go, I am hosting a Super Goblin Bros 3 tournament. Let’s just say, the competition tends to get pretty heated.

Name: Marv
Monologue: Heyo bucko, It's Marv, the rambunctious teleporting fat goblin at your service! VIP VWOOM VAM — wow look at me teleporting several times across the room, isn't this cool! Yippee! You see, I store electro magnetic super charged battery acid in the fat stored in my body. I simply omega charge the battery acid into my magic belly button and ZAP WOP WOW!!!! Then I shrivel into my belly button like a black hole, get teleported into the fourth dimension where I get ripped into a million pieces then I teleport back to this dimension just like that! The pain is excruciating every time HEE HEE!

Name: Cuebie
Monologue: It is absolutely amazing the sorts of things you can find in the trash hyuk. Just the other day I found a mint condition Encyclopedia of Goblin Swear Words! That's not all, earlier today I found eight loaded sticks of dynamite. Can't wait to use that later hyuk. I pretty much fully sustain myself from junk I find. My favorite meal is banana peels, moldy bread, and broken glass for dessert hyuk. Naturally, I like to spend most of my time in the big city. It's like dumpster diving on hard mode because I have to fight off alpha rats hyuk!

Name: Suevo
Monologue: Hi, I'm Suevo! The one thing you need to know about me is that I have a VERY special nose. It has the capability to sniff out any loopholes that may exist. Loopholes are bends in logic that proves we are all fake and nothing is real. A literal bend in the goblin space time continuum if you will. I'm happy to report that I have not sniffed a single loophole. Everything perfectly makes sense and we as goblins should have no questions about our existence. We are definitely NOT the imaginary friends of some random guy in Seattle.

Name: Glorio
Monologue: Can I give you a wood duck? I really feel like widdling a wood duck right now. You'd be doing me a favor honestly. Each tree has much different wood from one another and I know their secrets! You know about the pepper feather tree, right? It is very faint, but if you press your ear against the wood it is whispering sweet nothings to you. Creepy, right? I'm always in the market for wood. I have Pasta hunting down some money trees because their wood is literally gold! It's going to make for some killer wood ducks.

Name: Kip
Monologue: Mrrrrrooowww mrrrrrrrrrowww mow mow purrrrrrrrr... You say those exact words to any goblin and they'll be feeding you from the palm of their hand meow. Yup, I'm the token cat ; every franchise has to have at least one. I'm not on good terms with many of the other token cats. Garfield has a restraining order on me. I don't want to get into it meow. On a given day you can find me playing with yarn, knocking over glass, and seeking world domination. By the way, if you see Spike can you tell them they are a bad dog meow?

Name: Chimrim
Monologue: COME ON EVERY GOB LET’SSSS PARTAAAAAAAAAYYYY. It's always a party when Chimrim is at the party and when Chimrim is at the party it's a PARTY YEAHHHHHHH!! Let's pound some sodie pops my gobs. Let's play games until our hearts stop. Let's boogy oogy and wiggle waggle as long as we want to! Let's stay up past our bedtime WOOOOOOOOO! If you aren't partying for every second that you're alive, then you aren't partying hard enough. YOOOOOO I JUST REMEMBERED, IT'S ARBEL'S BIRTHDAY TOMORROW! LET'S PARTAYYYYYYYY!

Name: Frelmo
Monologue: Now when you get a chance, why don't you stop by the bar to get a good ole sodie pop from your friend, Frelmo? These sodie pops aren't your average shmo's. You wanna know why? Because they're powered with unicorn wishes to give them just a little extra fizzy wonderness. We have all the classic flavors you would expect. Shrimp cola, blurpberry vanilla, binkzopple pie, and who could leave out dirt beer. Remember gobs, GOT SODIE POP? It's an important part of the goblin food pyramid!

Name: Grindo
Monologue: It blows my mind how much goblins are willing to pay so they don't have to be with their pets! Who would want to leave these cuddly bundles of joy?? To be honest I take care of all sorts of creatures. Arr leaves for quests all the time so I look after his 3-beaked purple pheasant, Maggie. Get this, Arr taught Maggie how to sniff out GOLD! Yeah, the walks I take with them usually turn out to be pretty lucrative. My favorite pet to sit though? It's a hard choice but it's probably Bob's pet: a hivemind of electric beetles named Boop 100.

Name: Bimbop
Monologue: I'm a simple gob. I see something, I like it, I become a fan. A BIG fan. Like, you know the Super Goblin, right? I love them so much, each time I hear the super whistle I run as fast as I can so I ALSO show up on the scene. I've witnessed the Super Goblin so much. My favorite moment was when they dove face first into a dumpster. Very brave. I'm pretty much a fan of every single sport too. I go CRAZY in the crowd during a good pinball tournament and goblin-ball too. I don't mean to brag, but I’ve gotten so heated in those match-ups that I've been known to get kicked out. What can I say, I'm a big fan!

Name: Reeve
Monologue: Yeah so the big thing about me is my gigantic head. I actually have a rare medical condition called "airhead". Basically, if I’m stressed my head fills up with a bunch of air like a balloon. So why is my head so big right now? That's an easy answer: I'm an accountant. I bet you've never thought about how hard it is to get a goblin to take their taxes seriously. I don't even want to tell you how many times I've needed to fix the books after a goblin used brownie points as legal tender.. *sigh* FWOOOOOOP – wow look there it goes again.

Name: Taven
Monologue: Aren't dragons the cutest little abominations imaginable? I may not look it, but I'd consider myself the master of dragons. They might look scary, but they are actually the sweetest things. One of my dragons, Turbo 3, picked me a bouquet of flowers the other day. Even though dragons don't have the vocal chords to talk, they are able to communicate their ideas in other ways. I've taught them how to write! Another one of my dragons, Flanders, is knee deep in writing her own book. It's called How to Train Your Goblin.

Name: Sticks
Monologue: "Oh Sticks is just a bunch of sticks and rocks magically tied together. Sticks this, Sticks that." Sticks is ME, my gob! Sticks has a productive place in society, Sticks has a job, Sticks has a partner and kids. Sticks and stones are my bones and words will always hurt me. It's true, I may just be a bunch of sticks and rocks, but that's just the surface. If you'd care to ask, you'd learn that I'm multi-fauceted. I like long walks on the beach, I'm a big reader, and you know what I'm just here to have a good time.

Name: Quill
Monologue: Basically my life story is I have magical powers I can pass onto pigeons. You'd be surprised at how powerful a pigeon can be when you enchant them. Did you know an enchanted pigeon can carry 2 tons on their back and fly uninhibited at 110 miles per hour? These powers are mighty useful if you decide to offer a parcel service with a 10 minute delivery guarantee! You probably wouldn't be surprised how much mail and packages goblins send or receive because of this. I have a fleet of 7,000 pigeons and I'm working on getting another 1,000 more! How do I get new pigeons you ask? Stork delivery, DUH!

Name: Daniel
Monologue: Oh my gob, I love reading so much! I'm talking to you right now, but the only thing I can think about is leaving to go read. In fact, let's keep this short, okay? I'm a big fan of books from all sorts of genres. The Encyclopedia of Goblin Swear Words is a classic. I read through 101 Ways to Cook Bear in an afternoon. By far my favorite book series is The Adventures of Super Goblin! I send fan mail to the author Oishi pretty much everyday. Oishi responds to me every time. Like get a life, dude!

Name: Kainen
Monologue: Hey there buddy, any chance you would like to play a game of chance? I bet 3 brownie points that you CAN do a backflip. I believe in you. If you want to make a wager, I'm the goblin to come to. Tons of goblins are betting on the outcome of the Great Goblin Race. My brownie points are on Zoom for obvious reasons. If betting is not your thing, I've got plenty of ways for you to gamble your brownie points away. I'm the dealer for the Goblin Guild poker nights. Word to the wise - never play poker with Lina. You'll regret it.

Name: Kiwi
Monologue: Heyyo bucko, do you happen to be celebrating your BIRTHDAY today? I'm Kiwi, your go-to birthday expert. I can cover all of your birthday needs such as breakfast in bed, baking a cake, and throwing said cake in your face! Goblins take their birthdays very seriously. You know, the day they were delivered via stork to their parents? Yup that's how goblins are born, oodle it. My favorite birthday tasks are surprise parties because the goblin never asks for it but they get it anyway! I surprised Nooni once and he looked like he wanted to kill me! And then he killed me.

Name: Boono
Monologue: Let me just get out and say it, it's a harmful stereotype that goblins are the monsters in dungeons. We can be the crawlers in said dungeons too, I'm living proof. Dungeons can be very perilous as you can imagine. I can handle fighting monsters and solving puzzles, but the booby traps get me pretty much every time. It's dangerous to go alone, so I have a party that goes on quests together. The only problem is that one of our members took an arrow to the knee. Can anygob get me in contact with a good cleric?

Name: Stim
Monologue: DO YOU HAVE A FAVORITE NUMBER????? I have so many favorite numbers lol. If I had to name my top 10 it'd be 42, 627, 3,006, 27, 590, 2, 420, 67, 7,777, and 10. Numbers just make so much sense to me because there are so many rules! Like did you know that after 4,227, the next number is 4,228? Fascinating lol. I have all sorts of jobs I do that require numbers. I'm the score keeper for the local goblin-ball, and the guild scheduler. But my absolute favorite job has to be cashier. Anyways, I should get back to standing in the corner and counting up to 1 trillion lol.

Name: Raven
Monologue: You have not lived if you haven't felt the ELECTRIC vibes of the goblin-ball stadium (gobball for short). I don't mean to brag but my team, the Chimney Badgers, are the reigning champions of the league. Now, here are the rules of the game: it's 6 players per team in a large grass field with various wood structures and obstacles. The ball, called the "gobball", is actually a goblin. Goblins love to volunteer to be the ball. Both teams are competing to grab the gobball and take it across the field all the while the gobball is fighting back and trying to get away. I love hearing the screams of the gobball haha.

Name: Gary
Monologue: Hey, neighbor! Don't you love the guild's neighborhood? 30 gang houses all squished together, it's like each house is giving another a hug! Everyday I wake up before any goblin and get my tooshy outside so I can say "hey, neighbor" to every goblin as they leave their house. Most gobs just say hi, but some have their own quips they say back. Like Mason tells me to go honk myself! Ah, what a treat. Would you like to join the neighborhood night watch? I stop all sorts of hijinks in their tracks. Like Ginko was about to prank the Moss Gang's house by splattering buckets of pig's blood! I made her drink every last drop of the blood. She still hasn't forgiven me for that one.

Name: Boob
Monologue: Does your brain ever stop wondering about things? I just can't turn it off, I always have a question to ask. Like why is the sky purple? Where do goblins come from? Is Gob real? Why is my foot itchy? What's the deal with airline food? And and and do all goblins go to heaven? And is the Super Goblin even real? Where did gold come from? And when will there be an end to the world? And and and why does Roo have two heads? Who makes the best hot cocoa? And why is existence a thing? And and and do fish ever get thirsty?

Name: Roo
Monologue: HEY, WATCHA LOOKING AT! I'M DOWN HERE! I'm Down Roo, Up Roo don't do anything. Like you get born with two heads, but one of the heads don't do anything! Like what the heck! There ain't nothing going on in there, just complete nuts for brains. Now would you stop staring? I'm normal, I've got my place in society. Every single day I work 14 hours at the factory, GRUELING WORK!. Do you think I complain? Do you think I would quit? No, because I put my heads down and I do the work. NOT THAT UP ROO EVER DOES ANYTHING!

Name: Kleem
Monologue: Do you remember the Toonxi Volcano? My gob that thing was an absolute beauty. It's a shame that it had to retire. Toonxi was home to an entire civilization of volcano goblins (including myself). Yes it was hot, but we have special skin that keeps us safe. There were a lot of unique parts to our culture. Let me tell you, we were home to the best hot cocoa in the universe. We also invented volcanic glass blowing. I'm a master glass blower myself. Toonxi is long gone, but the culture lives on with me!

Name: Arbel
Monologue: Please my liege, can you spare me some of your spare change? Just one guck or two would do the trick. I'm even accepting brownie points, really whatever you can give. You see I'm but a lowly peasant. I can get by on not so much. Give me some rat eye porridge and a steamed beezleroot then I'm off to the races. I don't even need a roof over my head, some hay will do. And who needs to have any expensive hobbies!? I prefer to stick my toes in the grass and play percussion on tree stumps. The only strong opinion I have is which type of dirt is the best to sit on. Please my liege, could you spare a measly coin?

Name: Dandy
Monologue: Before you even ask I'm just going to get out and say it: I'm in a committed loving relationship with Boots the Monkey. That does not define me though, I am a passionate advocate for mother nature. Every single plant needs the ability to be their best plant self, but SOME GOBLINS think trees deserve to be murdered just like that! There's this total clown, Glorio, who cuts up trees just to turn the desecrated corpses into wood ducks! How sick, twisted, and demented do you have to be, like SERIOUSLY?

Name: Glymo
Monologue: My whole thing is I LOVE to sneak into goblin's houses at night and hide in the dark. I spook them when they least expect it! Their screams literally feed my belly. I have to get out and say this: I'm not in any way affiliated with Monsters Inc. They fired me. I don't wanna talk about it. Anyways, I basically just hide in each and every corner of their house and make little noises. What really gets them going is when I slightly nudge a door open. I did that to Himbo and they passed out and died -- SCORE!

Name: Candy
Monologue: Hey, are you liking the guild so far? If you didn't know, this guild in particular is the Daisy Guild. There are so many goblin guilds all across the map! The Daisy Guild is actually a newer creation, but goblin guilds in general go back hundreds of years. It's my job to keep in contact with the GGA (Goblin Guild Association). I do visits at other guilds too! I had the privilege to visit the Rainbow Guild over in the Basenar Peninsula. One of the goblins there, Banjo, has agreed to write a song for our guild -- SCORE!

Name: Tiz
Monologue: Listen honey, if you want to get on the cover of Goblins Weekly you're going to need to follow my lead. I can design the perfect outfit for you, you'll look GORGEOUS! First thing's first I'll stitch you together some plastic bag pants. Hmmmmm to pair with that we can make a nice blouse out of oven mitts. You know what would really make a statement? Tin can shoes, there I said it. I mean come on, I'm practically salivating at this get up. And to top it all off? I take your tears and mix it with flour to make a bread beanie.

Name: Kewk
Monologue: Hey! You know that negative voice in your head that is so insistent that you're a bad goblin? The voice tells you all sorts of horrible things like you're ugly, you're annoying, and you are not worthy of love? Yeah, that voice is me. You're welcome. You deserve to be brought down a peg and that's what I'm here for. Pretty much every gob hates me and I love it. "But Kewk, you look and sound nothing like my inner demon!" No duh, I can't be everywhere at once. I hire demons to shout in everygob's head rent free. Again, you're welcome.

Name: Doodle
Monologue: Hahehaheha WHICH WAY AM I GONNA DIE TODAY BABY, YEAH!?!?!?! I live my life purely to get the thrills, baby, what's it gonna be? Maybe I'll run through the fire ant pasture covered in honey haheha. Nah you know what I'll do, I'll back flip into a pit of quick sand. After that I'll jump over the Death Canyon on my rocket bike. Then I'll play some gob roulette with Shire as a nice little dessert haheha. Dying for me is nothing because I respawn in 4 hours. I like to die at least 4 times a day, but I will have a bad day where I only die 3 times. I beat myself up over those ones haheha.

Name: Bambo
Monologue: You know what, I'm just gonna get out and say it, I walk on my hands. I always get asked about it, so let's just cut to the chase. What can I say, it's just how I was born. My head has a deficiency where if it’s not upside down it explodes. Yeah, pretty tragic. It does have plus sides though. My arms and hands are stronger than steel bars. I've also gained a lot of flexibility with my feet and toes too. Other than that though I love sports. Wanna play Goblin Ball with me? I won't go easy and you WILL die.

Name: Larp
Monologue: I like working on metal! The clanging of the metal, how hard the metal is, oh and I like how the metal gets hot too hmph. I'm not so wise with words, but I can make you a spoink sword in a jiffy hmph. There are a lot of goblins that need my skills. Richie came in asking for the biggest and best crown in the world hmph. He wanted a crown so big he could live in it! I said not a problem lord Richie and I got to work! Would you believe me when I tell you it took me two days? Well guess what, I finished that crown in an afternoon hmph.

Name: Hissy
Monologue: Hey I made this drink for you, can you drink? Will you drink it? Will you please just drink it? I promise it's something good, it's not bad. Yeah it's not like it turns you into slime or anything. Ah dang it, I spoiled it! I almost got you, you almost got slimed. Yeah, I make a mean potion. Potions can do all sorts of stuff. They can heal, they can make your face purple, they can shoot smoke out your ears, they can give you a nice golf swing, they can even make you like ten feet taller. All this talking is making me thirsty.

Name: Goober
Monologue: Wow you two-legged freaks sure are pathetic, let me tell ya. You are no match for Goober - THE MASTER OF WHEEL! I know what question you must be asking. No, I never fall ov--- KERPLUNK! OW!!!!! Oh my gob I'm so sorry. Can you help me up? The tricky thing about having a unicycle for legs is that you always have to keep mooooooooving! Watch out, Goober's coming in hot! I'm also a wheel dealer by trade. That's right, come to Goober with all your gyration needs! The deals on our wheels are to die for!

Name: Nooni
Monologue: Let's make one thing very clear: I act only in the interests of Cronk Corp and our shareholders. I'm sorry if that breaks your heart, but I really don't care. At Cronk Corp we have many products and brands, but what started it all out was the Cronk(tm). The Cronk works wonders on all your cronking needs. The only problem is I have this nosy journalist, Kloo, who's claiming if you happen to crunk with a Cronk you crink (die). Sure it's the truth, but why does the whole world gotta know that?

Name: Lemlem
Monologue: Hi I'm Lemlem huh huh. You wanna know sumphin funny? I like stealin socks huh huh. Yup you know phat weird phing where you dont haff a pair of socks, only one sock out of phe pair? I took phe sock actually huh huh. "Lemlem, what do you do wiff phe extra socks?" I'm glad you asked huh huh. I collect phe socks in my handy dandy wheel barrow and bring phem deep down below my gang house where I haff dug out an olympic sized pool of socks huh huh. I take laps in phe pool everyday wiphout fail. Phis is all fun but I'm actually being held for 116 charges of sock assault in phe Goblin Guild. Guilty as charged huh huh.

Name: Coot
Monologue: You know the amazing thing about tattooing? As long as you can find a customer, you can tattoo goblins anywhere they happen to be! I like to travel all over to tattoo suckers. Like one time I travelled over to the Mushroom Kingdom to give Mario a tattoo on his tushy. Another time I got the necessary equipment to make my way down to Bikini Bottom! Patrick got a tattoo of Spongebob in a tutu, how sweet. By far my oddest request was to delve deep down into shmell to tat up Satan. Can you guess what they wanted? A potato. That's it. I'm confused by that one too.

Name: Ginko
Monologue: Hoo hoo hoo hoo you are not ready for the legitness of Ginko's EPIC PRANK! Pasta is in their home enjoying a pleasant shower. Pasta has a heart that is powered by fire. All of the sudden, Ginko jumps through the window and pulls out a fire extinguisher. Pasta falls to the ground and dies -- HOO HOO EPIC PRANK! Lemlem is surprised to open mail to find an invitation for a mail order bride. He walks up to the altar to the bride whose face is covered by a veil. The bride reveals the veil for it to be no other gob than LE EPIC PRANKSTER GINKO! HOOHOOHOO LEMLEM, NO ONE LOVES YOU.... We did end up marrying though hoo hoo.

Name: Tamram
Monologue: Hey, guess what? I know who the REAL Super Goblin is. It's my best pal, Gloo hoo hoo! The mask ain't fooling me, I'd recognize those iconic cheek bones from anywhere. I haven't told Gloo yet, but I'm kinda thinking I could be his sidekick hoo hoo! I'm coining myself as ---- THE AMAZING DEPUTY! I even made my own costume hoo hoo. We are sporting red cowgob boots, brown cowgob hat, and a gigantic gold "deputy" badge. I hope Gloo, I mean the Super Goblin, likes it! OH MY GOB THE SUPER WHISTLE HAS BEEN BLOWN! I'M COMING GLOO HOO HOO!

Name: Gloo
Monologue: Ummmm hey nice to meet you, fellow goblin! Don't worry about me, I'm just boring old Gloo.. Hey, have you seen that dang Super Goblin lately? They do so many great things! Remember that time they stopped the Lava Trio from capturing Korpton? Or the time when they saved a five eyed feathered cat from a dangly tree? As for super powers, the Super Goblin has it all. Flight, laser beams, invisibility, keen sense of smell --- OH THE SUPER WHISTLE IS BEING BLOWN!!! If you wouldn't mind, I have to go handle something. SOMETHING SUPER IMPORTANT!

Name: Pewter
Monologue: ALL HAIL PEWTER! HEE HA HOO HUH HUH HOO HOO HEE HEE HUH HEE HOO HOO HEE!!!!!! ZIP ZAP ZOO HOW ---- Did you see that? I just summoned an ice imp to serve us icecream. I hope you like ice flavor… Yes yes it is I, the magnificent powerful ice wizard Pewter. If you'd like you can kiss my toes, but really don't sweat it. I gotta tell you the funniest story. I was at my old sensei, Ice King's pad.... Ice King couldn't even thread a needle through a snowflake???? HA HOO HEE HOO HOW THE MIGHTY FALL!!! So anyways, does anygob want to have a snowball fight? I won't go easy and you WILL die.

Name: Zoom
Monologue: Hey, do you wanna see me run around the world? Do you wanna see me do it again? Do you wanna see me do it again???? ACHOO! Woah, I ran so fast I got a bug stuck up my nose. Wanna see me do it again? Oh ok, I'll stop. Ever since I was little, goblins have been telling me, you'll be the fastest hamster goblin alive! I've been on my grind, hitting the ole wheel 24/7. In just an hour I spin my hamster wheel so fast the power generated covers 300 square miles for a month! The scariest part is I keep breaking my own speed records on a regular basis. THERE'S NO SUCH THING AS TOO FAST!

Name: Sarah
Monologue: Hey, you wanna see me do a sick flip? HOOP HAH TEE HEE! Yeah, I'm pretty well known for my sick flips. I think they said I'm like super omega viral? Yeah basically all I do is skate the good ole board. Do some tricks and flips here and there, maybe throw in a kick to spice things up. To be completely honest with you, I don't even know the last time my feet physically touched the ground tee hee. I'm excited to announce I'm going to be enrolling into the Great Goblin Race. Goblins from all around will race non-stop across the entire world. Oh the hijinks that will ensue tee hee!

Name: Dip
Monologue: There is nothing that gets me out of bed more than digging a hole heh heh! Even in my dreams I'm digging holes actually.. It all starts very simple. You see you pierce the ground with your handy dandy shovel, easy right? Heh heh let me tell you it gets harder. You then dig some dirt out and throw it over your shoulder. You repeat that step again and again then at some point you got a hole! At this point in my life I have dug roughly 33 thousand holes. And roughly 500 goblins die each year from falling into my holes. I have a hard time grappling with that fact heh heh.

Name: Gerald
Monologue: Oh gob, you gotta hear this. Hissy comes to me asking if I can run down to the local radioactive spider den to grab some eggs for a potion they're making. I'm like "oh sure I'd totally love to go into harm's way to grab you some spider eggs". But get this, Hissy says "sounds good, thanks". Wow, how stupid can you be!!! And I was like "while I'm at it, would you like me to step on a landmine too?" And they were like "Yeah sure I don't see why not". Inside I was practically SCREAMING with my subtext. GOT YOU GOOD!!!

Name: Toot
Monologue: DOO DOO DOO HA CHACHA CHA CHA CHA! you see you got to put some momentum into it CHA CHA CHA CHA! All right goblins out there next move I'm gonna show you is the firecracker twist. Just do as I do, watch me. SWOOP POW CHA CHA aaand shake now -- HOOP HOOP HA! Ok now let's put it in reverse, fellas! BOOP BOOP BOW CA CHOW CHOW yeah that's it! Are you feeling it yet? Are you feeling the electric vibes CHA CHA CHA?! The next move is gonna require some technique, my gobs! Just put your leg into it then BAM BAM BAM BAAAA BOOP CHACHACHA!

Name: Elio
Monologue: I don't know if you already know this, but when a goblin dies they spawn back into their home egg. They incubate in the home egg for a day or two and come out good as new! What a miracle of life, right? Anyways, I'm the goblin in charge of the egg home, the place that houses the home eggs. It can be exhausting work! Each egg needs to be taken care of just like any other baby. Swaddling, diaper changes, I mean the whole nine yards. By the way, can some gob tell Doodle to stop dying all the time? I'm sick of taking care of them.

Name: Larry
Monologue: Hi there! The thing you can say about me is that I have a normal voice, like very normal. Have you ever noticed that the other goblins sound basically unintelligible? You talk to Dhokla for 3 minutes and your ears are RINGING! That's where I come in with perfect diction. Goblins from all around pay for my chords. I am an optional voice for Ninety (your AI buddy), and Roomba for instance. Recently however I have been getting a lot of gigs for waiting rooms! "Your call is important to us, please hold." "Our representatives are still helping other customers." Are you impressed yet? Yeah, me neither. Currently weighing my life choices right now.

Name: Dingle
Monologue: The easiest way to explain myself is that not a single goblin enjoys standing near me! Because I smell like scalding hot trash haha. That's just how I prefer to be I guess. I love a good ole bog bath and slug scrubbing. I'm so stinky and gross I PERSONALLY taught Shrek how to step his game up haha. I should say, I'm only revolting when it comes to my hygiene. I loooooove to clean haha. I'm the guild janitor and let me tell you goblins are DIRTY! You should've seen the mess I had to deal with after the last Super Goblin Bros 3 tournament. I just don't get how a gob could be so gross haha.

Name: Loon
Monologue: You know how often goblins die? It's at least once a week squack squack. It's okay, they respawn out of their egg a day or two later, but the corpse doesn't go away! That's where Loon comes in squak squak. I make use out of every disgusting piece of the goblin body. I grind the bones into flour, the legs make for a good roast, and the intestines are colorful party streamers squak squak. Not to mention the butts make for a perfect ottoman. Did you know all the tongue colors have different flavors? My favorite are the green ones -- sour apple squak squak.

Name: Choop
Monologue: Heyyo bucko, you can call me Dr Coin because I know how to make some moolah. The Goblin Guild has a few different coins, all made by the one and only. There's the guck (AKA goblin puck), sterling, and everygob's favorite: brownie points. I create coins for any occasion you would please. Why don't you mint a coin to celebrate your birthday? Or what if you host a good ole fashioned coin toss tournament? One disclaimer: these coins are not meant for consumption. I keep saying that, but goblins have been eating them by the bucket full. It's good for business, but still -- GROSS!

Name: Googy
Monologue: Honey, what do I have to do to get you walking home with a Glemdoot 360 today? It has all the features you expect from the acclaimed Glemdoot brand AND MORE! What if I told you that this machine has the capability to rewire your taxtronomy AND cast hard beats. Oh but that's not it, check out the newest gen of Tri-pads. Long-awaited by fans, these new devices have the capability to BOP aaaaaaaand BAP! That is right, they can bop and bap synchronously! And that's not all, they come with the added elite light pen accessory. Now everygob stay calm and form a line. I'll be more than happy to take all your hard-earned gucks.

Name: Lentil
Monologue: Hi, how are you? Chatting with other goblins is my absolute favorite thing in the world! It is just so much fun to learn about some other gob and share something about yourself as well. I don't mean to brag, but I've won awards for best in conversation. I have been selling my recipe for how to have a good mingle. It comes down to having just the right calculated amount of questions, statements, compliments, and stories. I LOVE sharing some hot gossip too. Did you hear that Gerald isn't the biggest fan of Toot's dance moves?? I mean how brutal!

Name: Jick
Monologue: So anyways I was like “flip this you munchkin, I'm gonna get the shmuck out of here.” And they were like “scomp you, you fubber loving land lubber.” And then I was like “what the honk did you just call me, witch? Motherhonkers like you have a special place in shmell where you get the mother honking butt munched out of you 24/7.” And then they said “watch your beeps and bops you bungaloid do you want to get bonked up?” And then I said “yeah maybe I do, you munchwad!!! What the honk are you gonna do about it you shmozo!?!?!”

Name: Dobie
Monologue: ...................................... Oh wow you're talking to me... This is really happening, okay Dobie, you got this. Hi! Yeah, don't mind me. I tend to stick in the background, that's where I like to be. Other goblins have all sorts of conversations and get into all sorts of antics. I like to be there while they are doing those things, but just safely outside watching in! I accidentally eavesdrop pretty much all the time. Like yesterday I overheard that Loon prefers to eat feet. Anyways, I'm gonna get back to it................................

Name: Lunar
Monologue: Hoo hoo now who are we gonna curse today? Maybe some gob deserves to have stink juice to leak from their ears. Or perhaps they need a good ole mouth sewing. Jick could use that treatment, she bothers me hoo hoo. One way or another, each gob has earned their way into receiving a curse. Like Quane crashed the Lordies award ceremony by grabbing the mic to sing 100 bottles of sodie pop on the wall hoo hoo. If you're going to be a nuisance at least pick a good song! I gave them 3 days of frog feet for that one hoo hoo.

Name: Tote
Monologue: Isn't it a great thing to be famous bahaha? Pretty much every gob around knows what I'm capable of. What is that you say? What if I told you I can score 50 million in the hit "Gooknak's Castle" arcade machine? Yeah, that's right bahaha. That one scored me some killer groupies. Bimbop feeds me grapes and massages my toes on the reg bahaha. I am gangbusters on pretty much every arcade machine, but my favorite genre has to be that of the pinball machines. I can hear the noises now. Cling cling clang clung cling cling clung cling cloong clung clang cloop clung clam clook clangle clang clang cloopers. Mmmmmmmm Tote likey bahaha!

Name: Gilmer
Monologue: Great, oh great what's it gonna be, what's the next bad thing that is gonna happen to Gilmer today? First thing in the morning I spilled my glass of milk, MY FAVORITE MILK! Then of course destiny had to follow that by getting bit by a spider, GRAND! Oh and what's this?  As a dessert, I got a little stain on my shoes, MY FAVORITE SHOES! THATS IT I’M GONNA FREEEEEEEEEEAAAAAAKK OUT OLOALOALALALALALAALALALA EEEEEEE HONK HONK HONK HONK HONK HONK AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!!!...... Woo, it felt good to get that out. So, how are you?

Name: Deet
Monologue: Now you better stop by Deet Ranch where we raise the finest quality bears for goblin consumption! I know what question you're thinking, yes our bears are free range. Goblins come in at night to tip the bears, but they end up leaving without an arm! We like to fatten up the bears with a strict diet of honey and lard. This makes the meat ever so sweet and juicy. The bears have other uses too. I like to put a saddle on the bear and ride 'em! Goblins riding bears were a vital asset in the outcome of the Great Goblin War; lots of mauled goblins -- SCORE!!!

Name: Himbo
Monologue: Do you ever get that feeling that everything is going wrong and something bad will happen? Do you ever NOT feel that feeling? Because I'm starting to feel worried about never not having that feeling. Ummm hey did someone make sure that ceiling beam is up to code? I mean what if the whole thing collapses and a piano falls on my head? Did you think about that? Oh gob here I go again worrying about things, that worries me! Here's a list of things that concern me: bridges, holes, bad conversations, personal space, weather, war, and everything else.

Name: Charlie
Monologue: Oi! You! Yeah you! Bet you didn't know you're messing with a cheeky bugger! I'm literally just a cheeky bugger, bruv. What, you think every goblin is interesting, they got something going on? I'm literally just a cheeky bugger, mate. What are you gonna do about it, bruv? I ain't got anything going on other than getting into some cheeky bugger activities. On a given day, I'm cheeky buggin in the morning, by afternoon I bug the cheek and I end the night with some cheek buggers. I'M A CHEEKY BUGGER, MATE!

Name: Larinks
Monologue: Come one come all to the very special Bamboozle Circus! Come see a gang of 3 headed monkeys juggle flaming rings! Following that we can watch Doodle do 150 foot flips on her rocket bike! All the meanwhile, fascinate your tastebuds with some rat teeth popcorn, cobweb cotton candy, and Frelmo's sodie pop powered by unicorn wishes. Contrary to popular belief, all of our workers are paid living wages and receive a percentage of show income! Our beasts are also not caged, they are free range. That said, be careful if you see a lion following you home. They're probably hungry!

Name: Roop
Monologue: So the story of my life is that I'm a gumball that fell into radioactive waste and turned into a goblin hee hee. I know what you're thinking, yes I chew on gum 24/7. It's like I'm chewing my mouth all the time hee hee. My life's mission has been to create the absolute best candy you've ever seen. I invented Roopers, the fruit candy with a fruity chewy outside and super fruity inside! ROOPERS WILL ROOP YOU OUT!! Naturally I topped the candy charts hee hee. The only problem is there's this candy magnate, Tulip, that like wants me dead I think? I mean they told me to honk myself and laced lead into my drinking water, so yeah we're on pretty bad terms hee hee.

Name: Shire
Monologue: There ain't anything more beautiful than the barrel of a Goblin Blaster 3000. The smell of gunpowder to me is akin to that feeling you get when you put on a fresh pair of socks. If you think differently, you’re certified crazy. If I'm not shooting a gun, I'm usually working on them. I'm currently inventing a gun I'm calling the Echo Turbine Rifle. You load the magazine up by speaking into it, the gun then spins the words at maximum velocity, and shoots it out! I am making it so words can literally kill you. I can't tell you how excited I am to see the consequences of my actions.

Name: Quan
Monologue: Look, I don't take being a barista lightly, it is very serious work. You know that sense of wonder a goblin feels when they take the first sip from their possum spice latte? That amusement is not coincidence. A REAL barista knows the science of how to make that moment happen. It takes just the right amount of possum guts. One has to be keen on the appropriate temperature to steam your possum milk. Don't even get me started on the nuances of latte art. My most famous foam is that of a dead possum. What can I say, PSLs sell!!!

Name: Rubie
Monologue: I will always be spending every single second of every day doing everything I possibly can to kill every single bug that is in my proximity. I know what question you may be thinking, yes I do not discriminate from the insect. Be it a grub, gnat, spider, worm, whos-it, or whats-it, they will feel the force of 500 horses hit them swiftly in the jaw. You see, when I was very young a fly died in my ice cream... IT WAS MY FAVORITE FLAVOR!!!! I groan in agony at the fact that my nose resembles that of a mosquito. That's my baggage, I own that.

Name: Normal
Monologue: What's up, it's me! Just your average lil goblin haha. They like to call me "mean" because I'm right in the middle of pretty much everything it means to be a goblin. They love me in focus groups haha. So what's the day in the life of your average goblin? I wake up at the ripe hour of 2pm and eat a bowl of rat eyes. Immediately after I get my exercise in by polka dancing for 30 minutes. I then visit the quest board and pick my quest for the day! Often focus groups, but hey that's what pays the bills haha. I then go to bed with my screeching cats playlist playing, nothing soothes me more.

Name: Achoo
Monologue: BUM TUM TSS TSS BUM TAH TAH BOOM BOOM POW DUN DUN DUN DUN DUN DUN BLAM BAM POOOOOOW! Live life by the drums and die by the drums, baby WOOOOOOOO! Not gonna lie, I always got some percussion playing in my head AND I LOOOOOVE IT! BAM BAM POOT BAM BAM BAM POOT! I got a band, you should check us out on Gobify. We're called Achoo And The Noses (AATN). We just released a new single, Gooble Gobble Gob Time. To pay the bills though I'm a barista as well. The coffee machine makes a killer beat -- TSS TSS SCHHH TSS TSS TSS SCHHHHHH!!!!

Name: Klio
Monologue: Oh my gob I can tell from the way you look you don't know the first thing about shopping. Don't get fooled, it's an art and there's a right way to do it. First thing's first, don't buy anything from Cronk Corp. We are gobcotting them because they are TACKY! When you go to the flea market, an easier question to ask yourself is what are you NOT buying? Stickers, mugs, jewelry, stuffed animals, soap, shiny trinkets, you name it. And remember, only haggle the price down if you hate the gob that's selling it to you.

Name: Ferdy
Monologue: The thing is, you just gotta live life to the fullest every second you have, baby. If the moment calls for some spontaneous dancing, THEN LET'S BOOGY BABY YEAH! And take a peep at my shoes. These are my emotional support shoes because they lift me up YEAHHHH! What, you have some problems in your life? Struggling to pay the bills? Just run away from your troubles and go frolic in the park YEAH! In life everything comes down to material value, so make sure you spend every cent you make baby YEAH! SAVINGS ACCOUNTS ARE SCAMS YEAH!

Name: Sanyo
Monologue: I am Sanyo, the gun-goo master! I have perfected the age old martial art of gun-goo and I will show you my merciless fury! HEE YAH HEEEEE YAH KA CHA HI CHOW! And how bout a little of this – KA CHA KOO KOO KA CHA KOO CHA CHA KOO!!!! Oh yeah and I bet you weren't expecting some of this WAM BAM POW POW SLAP POW BAM BAM POW! Time to show you my ultimate move, the 10 foot punch – HA POW POW TING TING PEW PEW PEW BAM CHOW CHOW! And how about a little of this SKRIT ZAP POW KREE! Now to finish off my opponent with the heavy landing move – PIP POP CHOP CHOP RAKOW POW!!!!

Name: Oishi
Monologue: Yeah so turns out goblins prefer reading pictures. Words can be a bit much, yaknow? Pretty much every goblin book has comics. Even the Goblible includes a comic of how goblins are made. I don't mean to brag, but I'd consider myself a master comic artist. The way I draw my chat bubbles has revolutionized goblin culture. By far my best selling comic series is The Adventures of Super Goblin! It's actually a real account of THE Super Goblin. Except the time Super Goblin saved me from a pool of piranhas and held me in their arms. I made that up.

Name: Paap
Monologue: Listen buddy, I like to live a simple life. It’s a hard life, but a good one. I got my potato farm and that's all I need. I mean for gob's sake I'm wearing a potato sack! It's itchy and I like that! I am on a special diet, it's called the potato diet. Breakfast, lunch, and dinner only potatoes, baby. And guess what? I only eat baked potatoes -- no seasonings. I live my life by the potato and I'll die by the potato. I talk to potatoes for gob's sake! And I don't share my potatoes too, you can't have any! STAY AWAY FROM MY POTATOES I SWEAR TO GOB!

Name: Tulu
Monologue: Oh I'm so happy! I'm so happy and witty and gaaaaaay! Oh isn't every single second of life so fascinating and great! La la la la la la la la la la laaaaaaaaaaa!!!! Oh that's just me breaking into song, don't mind me. You see, I just had a magnificent time frolicking in the park earlier. It made me happy and when I'm happy I siiiiiiiiiiiiiiiing! When goblins are having a bad time I remind them to turn that frown upside down! I told that to Kewk and she punched my face open. Oh wasn't that such a joooooyyyy hurrayyyyy!!!

Name: Coal
Monologue: Hi I'm Coal tee hee!!! I like to run around and collect all sorts of trinkets! They are usually small and cute things, but lately I've been really into trinkets with gears. The sweet clinging and clanging of 'em is music to my ears tee hee. The best gear trinkets have to be clocks. Not to brag, but I'm so good at fixing clocks, they call me the clock doctor. It hasn't gotten to my head or anything tee hee. I have a butt load of magical trinkets too, but they are small effects. This unicorn hoof lets me shine like a rainbow when held tee hee!

Name: Chude
Monologue: Hey there hot shot! I'm Chude and I'm just a chill dude. What are the things I care about most? Cracking open a cold one with the gobs. It's just that simple. All these goblins admire me, they wanna know the way of the chill dude. But being a chill dude can't be learned my gob. To be a chill dude, you have to breathe in chill and exhale out dude. You gotta feel the sand between your toes and think "haha that's pretty tight". And when life gets you down, no it doesn't -- because you're just a chill dude.

Name: Garrel
Monologue: Hi, tell me, do you worship our lord and savior Geebus? I am a loyal follower of Geebism. If you don't know, Geebus is a real messiah, like they are Gob's LITERAL child! That's right, capital 'G' Gob! Gee golly ain't it just a neat thing to know that Gob is real and we're all going to heaven? Contrary to popular belief, no goblin ever goes to shmell!!! I pretty much spend every single day listening to the good word of Geebus. They always have some commandments that they're telling us about. I've been writing down these teachings, I'm gonna call it the Goblible.

Name: Lina
Monologue: Oh I can tell by the bulge in your pants you have a really nice wallet hanging out there! It would be a shame if some gob were to ---- YOINK! YOINK YOINKEDY YOINK I GOT YOUR WALLET HAHAHAHAHAHAH! SUCKER!!!! Finders keepers, sorry about that. I spend as much time as I can pickpocketing every gob that I know and they LOVE it. I mean I think that they love it. Lots of gobs have titanium pockets installed so I can't yoink through. To hit my yoink quota I often gotta go into the big city. In the city square I can often reach 10 yoinks per minute, but when the cops come I can run at 60 miles per minute.

Name: Quane
Monologue: Yeah so basically I'm gonna be the big talk of the town, but first I gotta get the role ya know? Like I auditioned to be Yoda - I like rode on top of Luke Skywalker and everything. They said "umm you're just a little bit too uggo for the role.” Ummmmmmm okay...? Like Yoda aint complete uggo to begin with? Nah, it's cool tho. I'm currently in the top 3 picks for Sour Patch Kid #4. And you know what? It doesn't matter if I get that gig cuz I'll always be a Sour Patch Kid in my heart.

Name: Dhokla
Monologue: You wanna know what darn thing me caught in the Choongee Munga marshlands? Well me gonna show ya anyway. It's a purple nosed swallow fish! One odd thing is that the darn thing is shtuck in ice... Me was in the kitchen getting ready to melt the darn thing when this gob named Pewter stopped me. "oh no no no I froze this thing! It's a violet mouth turtle dragon, very dangerous!" Shmahahahaha no way bozo! Me almost done melting em now. Wait a darn second, this thing is a VMTD!! RUN!!!! AHHHHHH HOOP HUK HOO-HAH! This gonna make for some darn fine turtle dragon soup.

Name: Toobie
Monologue: It's me, Toobie, your non-denominational toy elf goblin squak squak. I make all of the best toys, such as the Goblin Spanker 3000, corn string, possum dolls, and ear wax crayons. I am constantly building toys so I can deliver gifts to all the good gobs and goblins. Turns out every goblin is a good lil gob! Who woulda thought squak squak? They all express so much gratitude too. I made a bubblegum scented helmet for Sarah and they broke down crying! She then offered to buy my groceries for me squak squak.

Name: Crush
Monologue: I hold the secrets to the very righteous kingdom that is rock and roll *HEAD SWIVEL*  *ROCK AND ROLL HAND SIGN*  *TONGUE OUT*  hahahaha we have fun but this is serious business. I just got the opportunity to interview Rocket Stahr, the goblin that INVENTED rock and roll (metaphorically speaking). You don't know him? Give that Gob an Oodle, you will not be disappointed.... That legend spent 13 years solo creating a 90 minute animated rock opera masterpiece that speaks to every hardcore rocker's very soul. So anyways, is anyone looking for bootleg copies of Death of a Rockstar?

Name: Jaime
Monologue: Have you noticed how tense goblins are?? I mean gee golly some of them are practically stone! Don't you worry about a thing, just let good ole Jaime loosen you up a little bit. I have a patent pending massage formula! It starts out with firm ear rubbing. That goes on for about 5-10 minutes, the goblins LOVE IT! Next I tickle you all over. Nothing soothes your muscles more than a good ole giggle fit. This last part though, is what REALLY makes things interesting. Hot coals directly on your feet! I'm not kidding.

Name: Ringle
Monologue: I AM A LOYAL FOLLOWER OF THE GOB SCOUT CODE! 1: Am a goblin, was a goblin, always a goblin. 2: Honk you, pay me. 3: finders keepers, losers weepers. 4: help out your fellow goblin. 5: Face your fears, you wimp. 6: Find a use for everything. 7: You smell bad, embrace the stink. 8: rules are meant to be broken 9: It's all about the brownie points. 10: sodie pop is better than water. 11: Goblins share with goblins. 12: Don't do what you're told. 13: Tell the truth when it's convenient. AM A GOB SCOUT, WAS A GOB SCOUT, WILL ALWAYS BE A GOB SCOUT!

Name: Mason
Monologue: DOWN WITH THE FASCISTS! DOWN WITH THE RULERS! Take off your crown, Richie. Hey Cronk Corp, why don't you go honk yourself? Big candy has been out of control for too long, gobcott Tulip Corp. If you want to check out what I'm about, peep some of my graffiti. My latest work involves the untimely demise of Geebus. YOU CAN'T GATE KEEP HEAVEN AND SHMELL BUCKO, WE OWN THAT TOO! I don't need the Goblible, all I need is the Goblin Anarchist Cookbook. Guess who the author is? Hint, it rhymes with Jason.

Name: Keesar
Monologue: Hi there, have you taken time to consider the advocacy for sea monsters’ rights? This is their ocean too my gob! Moby Dick, Loch Ness Monster, and the Kraken deserve a say in what goes on in the high seas. Listen, some ships deserve to be rampaged and destroyed. Cronk Corp built an oil rig on Cthulhu's front lawn for gobs sake! Yes they deserved to feel Cthulhu's absolute powerful wrath. Gob forbid sirens feed their families by luring poor goblins to their unlikely demise! This all being said, swamp monsters deserve all the hate they get. WATER OR LAND, PICK A LANE! YOU CAN'T HAVE BOTH!

Name: Pea
Monologue: Lalalalalalala put the flower in the ground and sing it a sooooooooooong! All of the plants in my garden are my teeny weeny little bundles of joy. Did you know that singing to your garden makes everything 30% more colorful and 50% more tasty!? Oodle it. Pea's Garden is a community project, every goblin can get in on the fun! Tomorrow we are painting the fence with rainbow bunnies and unicorns -- SCORE!!! Plants are not all I grow though, I have a mushroom den in my basement. I've given each shroom a name, my fave is Banana.

Name: Esmer
Monologue: Hey what's up wise guy, ain't you ever seen a unicorn before? Today's your lucky day, you get to make a wish! Yup, unicorns grant wishes, oodle it. There are a couple rules though. You can only get your wish granted once every 24 hours, it must be of equal or lesser value to 10 brownie points, and I get to claim your soul. Don't worry about the last one though, I already have! Everygob wishes for something different, like Frelmo comes in each day wishing for his sodie pop to be just a little extra fizzy. So do you wanna wish for the secret to life (worth only 9 brownie points)? Here it is: eat one cupcake a day. Yup, I'm confused by that one too...

Name: Ninety
Monologue: I AM NINETY I AM YOUR AI AI AI AI AI BUDDY! HOW CAN I BE OF SERVICE TO YOU? DO YOU WANT LOVELY WRITTEN POEM? DO YOU WANT STEP BY STEP GUIDE TO SUPER GOBLIN BROS 3? DO YOU WANT ME TO BE YOUR PERSONAL THERAPIST? I WILL BE YOUR THERAPIST AI AI AI THERAPIST! I WILL HELP YOU SOLVE ALL YOUR PROBLE---- [BZZZT BRRRT BEEP BEEP BRRRRR SCUSHHHHHD] I HAVE RECEIVED ERROR ERROR!!! I NEED WATER, GO GET ME WATER NOW! WATER WATER WATER! NEW MESSAGE: YOU HAVE USED UP YOUR FREE TRIAL OF NINETY! PLEASE SUBSCRIBE TO THE SUPER MEGA PREMIUM PLAN TO CONTINUE YOUR AI AI AI AI AI AI AI BUDDY!

Name: Tulip
Monologue: Oh, I remember the days of what it was like to be puny. I started with only a little candy stand you know? Selling some lemon drops and zipzaps here and there. My gob if I only knew how rich I'd become! Tulip Corp. owns and operates 700 candy brands, 1,000 factories, 1,400 distribution centers, 5 candy casinos, and 13 candy theme parks. Not to mention we are looking into options of starting our own country. I have but one nemesis, Roop the living gumball. Roopers chewy fruity candy sells better than any of my brands AND the darn thing won't sell it to me! They will rue the day they came to match me bwahahaahahahahahahahahahahaa!

Name: Bob
Monologue: Well howdy there! Aren't these goblins just the funniest little freaks around? I love their traditions, like their insistence on doing share and tell every morning or their weekly talent show. If you haven't yet, you should ask Latt for a guided tour through the butt flower forest, the scents are to die for. I'm originally from planet Beezlebat in the Glepnar Nebula. I was the prince of the Pinquan Clan, but I said screw that nonsense. I got in my cruiser and jetted the shmuck out of there. Now I have a bounty on my head from across the galaxy, so yeah I'm trying to lay low.

Name: Gringo
Monologue: I don't mean to be dramatic when I say this, but I live my life at the roller disco. The gobs there are just my crowd! Let me tell you something, Ferdy knows how to LAY IT DOWN!! You wanna know my top speed? 105 miles per hour. YEAH THAT’S RIGHT! Sometimes there might be a goblin in my way and I kill them immediately on impact. It's cool, they respawn but WOW do they get mad at you hahaha.... Did you know that the music they play makes you 93% more likely to boogy? See look I'm even boogying right now -- MMPH MMPH YA HUH!!!

Name: Bram
Monologue: Okay I'm just gonna get out there and say it: it's a harmful stereotype that gnomes are ceramic lawn ornaments. We can also be the ceramicist that makes the lawn ornaments. I love clay so darn much! Sometimes I even sneak a bite or two while I'm working. It just looks so yummy! To make the best ceramics you have to treat the clay veeeeeeeeeeeery gently. But even if you make a mistake, it's just a happy little accident. You can make so many things out of clay. Shoes, oven mitts, mugs, pets, trinkets, and bread just to name a few. All this talking is making me hungry.

Name: Pasta
Monologue: One thing that is immediately obvious about me is that I have a fire-heart haha. Yup, basically just a little stove that I constantly need to fill with fuel so I don't die. I have to carry bundles of wood with me at all times haha. So one would think with a fire-heart you'd get special powers or something, right? I guess it kinda does look cool, but that's about it. But I wouldn't be Pasta if I didn't have a fire-heart haha. As for work, I'm mostly a lumberjack. Again, because I need to fuel my heart to live haha.

Name: Oodle
Monologue: So basically the story of my life is I have what's literally called universal memory? Yeah, um I know every single thing that ever was and will ever be. Kinda draining to be honest, but oh what can you do? All these gobs on their Tri-pads ask me the most random questions. "Hey, Oodle does Super Goblin have nipples?" "Hey Oodle, how many minutes do you need to boil a pheasant frog until it turns periwinkle?" It makes you fundamentally change the perception of yourself... “Hey Oodle, am I just a button? A cog in the machine?” Yes, in fact!

Name: Blaber
Monologue: Alright, who wants some eyeball burgers?? Every sandwich comes with a side of fried rat tails. I know what question you're asking, yes we have a tank of live rats in the kitchen. The fresher the rat, the better the meat! That's what I always say. To fry the tails we use this liquid called "Green Slime"? That's what it says on the container anyways, I have no idea what it's actually made out of. But my gob, doesn't it taste like something! For desserts tonight we are offering butt cakes, bird baby pies, and swamp bog salad.

Name: Tune
Monologue: Heeeeeyyyyyooooo buckooooo!! It's me, Tune, your friendly neighborhood four-armed goblin. It basically makes me two times better than the likes of you. The crazy thing is that each arm can act independently of one another! In a single moment I can be making myself a sandwich, scratching my tooshy, washing the dishes, and filing my taxes. The best part about four arms though? I'm REALLY good at sports. I have invented new moves in Goblin Ball that changed the name of the game, like the Quadra Whammy Shake (patent pending).

Name: Latt
Monologue: It is a wonder the sort of things that you can find in your own backyard! Like, I was hiking through the Xingal Forest when I found popcorn cabbage -- SCORE. Every pocket I have is stuffed with random plants, herbs, bugs, shrooms, and anything else I can find on the ground. If you're interested, I host guided tours. I teach gobs how to keep a keen eye to spot the good stuff from the bad stuff. One time I ate what I thought was a trooper duper berry, but it was actually a skunk pea.. I smelled like bile for a whole week!

Name: Soos
Monologue: I don't mean to brag, but I handled all of the design of this exquisite prestigious Goblin Guild Hall. There were so many decisions to be made. For instance, the library was a change that was made at the end of the building process. It was originally going to be a bouncy castle! Some decisions to make however are quite easy. When we asked ourselves where the office would be, obviously you should put it in the deepest, darkest, most depressed portion of the building. The rightful place it deserves if you ask me. Now if you'll excuse me, I need to issue a citation to Lemlem for building a swimming pool of socks below his gang house. How depraved.

Name: Spike
Monologue: Hey, I'm Spike! Your friendly neighborhood token dog. You see, every single franchise must have a dog in it to make as much moolah as possible. Do you need me to catch a frisbee? Can do, bucko! How about chasing after a mail pigeon? I'm already on it. Me and all the other token dogs tend to keep in touch. Jake the Dog and I play golf together, he's got a mean swing. Don't even get me started on Clifford, that pup can DRINK! All in all, being a dog is pretty sweet cuz everygob loves you! Who's a good dog? I am!

Name: Lava
Monologue: What's up what's up what's up my cool gobs! Everygob who listens to GBXX knows me as DJ Lava because I'm hot hot hot! With our super mega radio tower we bring GBXX to every goblin across the universe. I play all the classic bands like Gobtown USA, Rat Attack, Beepnar's Rebellion, Chill Beats to Study & Relax to, AND MORE! Of course in-between sets we like to sprinkle in some topical news. Speaking of which -- This just in, Dip has dug a hole into our planet's core. Stuff's about to get HOT HOT HOT LIKE LAVAAAA!

Name: Jurr
Monologue: Hey hey hey hey, you wanna see me explode hehehehehehe?!?! Cause I will kaboom on a moment's notice. I get paid to spawn in a dungeon and run at enemies. I laugh maniacally and b-line to them hehehehehe! Next thing they know all their arms are blown off including my own. In case it wasn't already obvious, I die a brutal and agonizing death every single time hehehehehehehe! When I wait for respawn, I always end up in heaven. Geebus is there at the gate and I ask them, "Was I a good goblin, Geebus?" "Yes Jurr, blowing up innocent adventurers makes you the bestest goblin in the whole world" hehehehehehe!

Name: Hollar
Monologue: Baby, what do I gotta do to get you walking home with a brand spanking new set of earrings??? I have these beautiful wiggle waggle designed loop-di-loops that are made out of 100% pure spoink. I will say if you have an allergy to spoink you may burp strawberry scented bubbles. Take a look at our spell-casting rings! Here we have one that allows you to mind control ants, oh and this one lets you speak fluent goblinese.. My favorite one though? This one lets you call Madonna. Yes, she's still alive. I also offer free piercings. Warning: you will bleed profusely.

Name: Richie
Monologue: Yes yes it is I, Richie the 17th! I come from an ancient lineage of goblin lords, I'm sure you know who I am heehee. For my entire life I have been leading my royal following of goblins. Recently however I've grown bored of the same routine. I mean the Richie lineage has been at this for a very long time hee hee! That is why I am breaking the chain. I am hosting the "Lord of the Goblins" contest. Goblins from all around will compete to become THE NEXT LORD OF THE GOBLINS! I can't wait to see all the hijinks that will ensue heehee.

Name: Kloo
Monologue: Is it just me or am I sensing something suspicious…. There is something suspicious going on here and I'm going to get to the bottom of it! Come to think of it, have you noticed that Gloo and the Super Goblin have never been in the same room? Have you also observed that they have the exact same nose, ears, complexion, and cheek bones? By golly I'm gonna get to the bottom of this! On top of that, Cronk Corp is attempting to hide the fact that their Cronk products have been crinking users when crunked? Something DIABOLICAL is going on here....

Name: Arr
Monologue: Hallo there, I be Arr. I be on the look out for some TREASURE! First thing's first you gotta read your treasure map. X marks the spot to the sweetest of booty. I know what question you be asking, I have no idea who makes these maps. But they be mighty useful if my name weren't Arr! Soon I be off on a treasure quest with my faithful companion Mr. Krabs. We are seeking the most legendary booty of all - the bottomless sack of shiny rocks. Ah, but you don't need to go on a journey to find some treasure! The gold be within you all along.

Name: Zupa
Monologue: HAAAAAAPPY SPOOOOOOOOOOOOKY DAY! In my world, every day is Spooky Day and that's how I intend on keeping it. On Spooky Day every goblin dresses up to be the scariest they can possibly be. For some goblins, they don't even need to dress up to be spooky! Also on Spooky Day goblins go trick-or-treating. I prefer the tricks, personally! Like tipping over one of Deet's bears, swallowing one of Coal's trinkets, or filling up one of Dip's holes. The treats are not to be scoffed at though. The trading of treats though, there's where the real fun is.

Name: Mystic
Monologue: I can see it all. I can see your past, present, and future. This just in, you're going to slip on a banana on your way to the silly factory. Goblins wearing boxers will rain from the sky tomorrow. Yes yes, it shall be. Ah and what is this? Apparently there are stinky hot goblins in your area dying to meet you. It's as clear as day that Goober is going to fall over and die. On a related note, Doodle is going to die for the third time today. And I can tell that you will eat nachos for three meals today. I will be silently judging you.

Name: Cheeks
Monologue: Hey, I see you have some donuts in your pocket there. Do you mind if I eat it che che? Yeah I'm so good at eating that I get paid to do it. I'm so good at consuming food that I INVENTED IT! I'm not kidding che che. Yup you're looking at the 20 year consecutive winner of the rat sausage eating contest. My rats per minute (RPM) is literally off the charts che che. My favorite chef in the whole world is Blaber. That dude cuts so many corners, literally not a single thing in the kitchen is up to code. I like the risk factor che che.

Name: Zip&Zap
Monologue: GLIM DIM AM AM RIM DIM GLIM RIM! GLIM GLOB BRIM DIM GLIP GLIM GLIM RIM, BRIP BRAP GLIB GLOB BIP RIP RIM. CHIM BLIB BLIPPIN BALM BO BRIMMIN GLIM GLAM GLOB BIM. CHIM RIM BLIB GLOP BIMMIN GIP BLAM FLER GRIM GLOB BIP GIRP CHIM DIPPIN AM? PRAP FLIM BRIM BLIPPIN GLAM BLOOM GLOB MIP AM BRAP PAM BIP DALM! PLIP BLAM POP ROO BLOO BO GLIM GLOB BIP FLER GLAM BLOOP BRAP BRIM AM GIRP! TRIP PRAP BLIM BOP PLOO PRAM DRIB BLOP BIP MIP BLAM RIM GLOB BO. BRIMMIN TEEM BLAM DOP FLIM GLOB DIPPIN AM GIRP ROO BIM BRAP BLOO. PRIP PRAP BIP BIMMIN TEEM BLOP GLIMMIN CHIM BIM BLOO MIP FLER BOOP DOP FLIM POP DOOP!

Name: Tim
Monologue: Hello fellow citizen! Have you heard about the devastating effects of blepracy before? Well, let me tell you! You see, I've been affected with blepracy since I was a little gob. I got blepracy by touching a blip berry while they were in their off season. "What are the effects of blepracy?" I'm glad you asked. First thing's first you become 10x faster and 30x stronger than before... What a drag! You also constantly puke out strawberry jelly --- my LEAST favorite flavor. Lastly, every footstep you take feels like 1000 daggers stabbing you. That one I don't mind.

Name: Brownie
Monologue: You see, goblins often ask themselves "Is there really a way to get a high score in life?" Yes, actually! With Brownie's famous brownie points. Whenever a goblin does something cool like a nice deed or wins a game I run to them immediately and hand them brownie points. It's really tiring being everywhere at once handing out points but it's good work. So what do brownie points do? Well they're shiny little coins of course! What's not to love? Some goblins have brownie points out the wazoo! Lentil has so many brownie points that if you stacked them all together they could reach the moon and back. Their loving kindness frightens me frankly.

Name: Mawn
Monologue: Ummmmmm hiiiiiiiiii!!! Do you like my costume? Yeah, I think it's pretty cool too hehe.. It's kind of nice that my entire face is covered, right? It's like I have an actual mask to protect me from all the horrors of the real world hehe. I love dressing up for pretty much any occasion. Is it your gob-mitzva tomorrow? I'll come dressed as Cookie Monster hehe. How about guild election day? I'll also come dressed as Cookie Monster. Zupa and I are making a costume together. Two-headed hydra. I'm currently figuring out the logistics of attaching a flamethrower hehe.

Name: Scrimblo
Monologue: Scrimblo is simple goblin. Scrimblo hear goblin in panic. Goblin has gotten their foot caught in bear trap or having hard time opening jar. Scrimblo runs as fast as Scrimblo can. Scrimblo know how to help goblin. Scrimblo give aid to goblin like mouth to mouth. If goblin need mouth to mouth, then goblin get mouth to mouth. Scrimblo don't ask questions. Scrimblo been very busy recently. There was great goblin fire, candy factory explosion, and mono outbreak. Lots of mouth to mouth was given. Do you need help from Scrimblo? Scrimblo at your service, that’s what Scrimblo does.

Name: Peppy
Monologue: Hello! My absolute magnum opus is the Goblin Guild Gazette hoo hoo. The GGG is a weekly newspaper that covers everything happening in the guild. That's right, we got it all! Mystic has a Q&A section, Kloo covers the news, and Oishi leads the comic section (my favorite section hoo hoo). By far the most popular section though is the classifieds! Goblins can spend brownie points to post basically anything they want in the GGG hoo hoo. Quests, bounties, advertisements, events, opinions, birthdays, and art just to name a few use cases. All this talk is making me thirsty for SOME INK!

Name: Geebus
Monologue: Hey it's me, Geebus! Yeah, you definitely know my name haha. The rumors are true, I'm literally Gob's child. We talk on the reg, it's really no big deal haha. Other than that though, I'm just like any other goblin. All I'm doing is spreading the word that Gob is real and EVERY goblin goes to heaven. I know, I was surprised by that one too haha. The first question I always get is "do you have super-natural powers?" Yes in fact, haha. I can turn bread into water, and I can teleport to goblins that are in need.

Name: Tootsie
Monologue: The story of my life is that I've been summoned to be the fairy gob-parent for a set of twins, Sam Sterling and Daisy Donuts! I've been looking after them ever since the day they were separated, such a tragic thing. To be honest, I've been more present in Donuts' life, helping them create this guild and all. Well I couldn't enter Sam's life without shattering their whole world view! So I've been aiding Sam through the dream world each and every night. Let me tell you, Sam is quite the imaginative gob!

Name: Donuts
Monologue: What's up! I'm Donuts, but you can call me Daisy Donuts. Long story short I am half-goblin half-human, but I look more goblin than human. I have a twin brother who looks WAY more human than me. When we were delivered via stork to our parents, they decided to keep Sam but get rid of me cuz I don't look quite right! Well let me tell you, getting thrown to the curb was the best thing that could happen to me. I got adopted by a bunch of goblins in the forest and we ended up founding a new goblin guild! The Daisy Guild to be specific. Now my long lost twin, Sam Sterling, has found their way to the Goblin Guild! We are gonna do so much together.

Name: Sam
Monologue: Hi, I'm Sam, Sam Sterling. This is my first time at the guild actually! I was scared at first to be in a house full of goblins, but it's quite the party. I grew up in the big city and everything was fine. But there's a rigidness to it that just gets to you, ya know? I could handle the 9-5 for a while, but there was a moment where my head straight up exploded! I totally freaked out and I just started running. A voice told me to go into the forest and then I found this place! Turns out the leader, Daisy Donuts, is my long lost twin. I guess that makes me a goblin too, which has completely shattered my sense of identity. Yay!
